# Harbor handoff study

## 1\. Purpose

This synthetic study compares two inspection routes over six weekday trials. The observations describe this sample only; weather and staffing were held constant.

## 2\. Findings

Table 1 records median elapsed time and the number of missed handoffs. Route Median (min) Missed handoffs Check first 12 1 Test first 19 3 The check-first route was faster by 7 minutes, but this is not a causal estimate.

Figure 1. Gate order:

- check, test, then release;
- each gate must pass before the next.

## 3\. Limits

The trial excluded overnight operations and must not be generalized to storms.

## 4\. References

- [1] Harbor Lab. Handoff protocol, synthetic edition, 2026, sections 2-3.
- [2] Harbor Lab. Trial log, synthetic edition, 2026, entries 1-6.

## Appendix A. Observation rule

A missed handoff means a parcel waited more than 5 minutes after its release signal. Observers recorded one timestamp per gate and did not change the route mid-trial.
